## Scope check

- [ ] This does not require editing anything under `hello/core/` by hand.
- [ ] This does not require a language that Linguist leaves uncoloured.
- [ ] This can be generated by a script, rather than committed as output.

> Two hard constraints, both structural rather than opinionated:
>
> 1. `hello/core/` is regenerated by CI. A hand-edited file there is silently
>    reverted.
> 2. A language GitHub gives no colour cannot appear on a colour bar at all.
>    COBOL is the canonical example.
